_comment: Completion state for the v1.0 work orders, consumed by tools/gen_tracker.py. States: done | partial | todo | blocked. Record 'done' only with evidence checked into this repo.

AX-001.note: All three leak sites closed (c840f9a). The audit's attribution to `archx_fn___archx_user_main` was wrong; the real defect was in the collection pipeline: (1) comprehension growth (cap==len so the last push reallocated), (2) the min/max generator temp claimed without being freed, (3) the for-each loop variable re-cloned over the previous binding. ASan now 11/11 CLEAN; ci/leakcheck.c is an independent gate that provably fails on a leak.

AX-002.note: Trapping `i64` via llvm.s*.with.overflow + checked_* const folding (e55ea1d): MAX+1, MAX*2, 2**63 all trap with exit 101, and a literal can no longer bypass the check by folding. REMAINING: explicit `wrapping_*` intrinsics for the native dialect, and `add nsw` only with a proof (the immediate check costs ~12% on composite; batching was rejected because it exposes the wrapped value before the panic).

AX-003.note: Version single-sourced: Cargo.toml 0.9.0 -> 0.9.1 (the CLI already read CARGO_PKG_VERSION; `archx --version` now prints 0.9.1) and benchmarks/run.sh now derives every version string from Cargo.toml instead of hard-coding 0.9.0. The README benchmark table is GENERATED from ci/out/benchmarks.txt by tools/sync_readme_benchmarks.py, which also rewrites the two perf claims; `--check` fails on drift and was verified to fail on an injected stale number. tools/check_test_count.py asserts the quoted count equals the `#[test]` attributes (79 = 41 unit + 38 CLI; the old 68 was stale). "(Current)" removed from the v0.8.0 changerog heading. Both checks run in CI. HONESTY FIX: the old claim `4.1x-69.8x faster than Python 3` silently omitted Suite 1 where Archx is 0.3x; the range is now `4.0x-71.2x` over Suites 2-7 with the Suite 1 loss stated in the same sentence, and the full_tour sentence no longer says it beats C (the CI run has C at 12 ms vs Archx 17 ms).

AX-005.note: LICENSE (MIT) added earlier. The binary problem was larger than the work order described: SIX tracked executables, not two (`bw`, `call_and_loop_semantics`, `d1`, `full_tour_pythonic`, `hello`, `pipelines`) — the other four are build output from `benchmarks/run.sh` that was committed by accident. All six are removed from the index and ignored by name; `tools/check_binaries.py` scans the magic number of every tracked blob (so it needs no `file(1)` and cannot miss an extensionless binary), is wired into CI, and was verified to fail on a planted ELF before being trusted. Acceptance met: zero ELF/Mach-O/PE files tracked.

AX-006.note: Needs a decision I cannot make alone: merging arena/888b3ea8-archx-lang into `main` and changing the default branch is a repo-level action affecting what `git clone` gives everyone. Depends on AX-003 and AX-005 landing first.

AX-013.note: Directive layer landed (b152f3b): src/dialect.rs, E0100/E0101, DialectSpec on Program, --dialect override. ACCEPTANCE PARTLY MET: `--emit-ir` now carries the dialect as llvm.module.flags (`archx.dialect` + `archx.directive_version`, behaviour bit 1 = Error), asserted by tests/cli.rs::dialect_directive_is_required_and_checked for both dialects. REMAINING: `NodeOrigin { dialect, span }` on Stmt/Expr (needs per-node spans, a larger change) — and `DialectRules` was removed because no pass read it; AX-016 reintroduces the table as the thing passes actually consult.

AX-004.note: All 15 warnings resolved and the gate is in CI. Dead code deleted (not allowed): `emit_pack_dict_key`, `clauses_carry`, `param_as_expr`, `declare_loop_var_in_outer_scope`, `forget_drop_target`, plus the never-constructed `StmtKind::ForElse` (AX-010). Unread parameters removed from signatures (`arr_name` in `emit_list_push_raw`/`emit_list_scan_var`, `span` in `gen_for`, `gen_foreach`, `gen_for_else`, `gen_foreach_else`), unused `mut`s dropped. `#[deny(dead_code)]` on `mod ast`. CI runs `RUSTFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo build --all-targets` on Linux and on both cross-platform runners; local release + all-targets builds are clean. NOTE: the acceptance text says `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`; the tree has never been clippy-clean (65 lints, incl. 27 `map_or` style suggestions), so the gate is rustc warnings. Clippy-clean is left as separate work rather than silently claimed.

AX-010.note: `StmtKind::ForElse` deleted from src/ast.rs: `For`, `ForEach`, `ForEnumerate`, `ForDictItems`, `ForZip`, `ForTupleUnpack` already each carry `else_body: Option<Vec<Stmt>>` and every one of them is constructed by the parser, so the variant was a second, unreachable representation. Its arms were removed from codegen/analysis.rs, codegen/mod.rs, codegen/generics.rs, codegen/stmt.rs and parser.rs. Acceptance met: one representation, loop tests unchanged and green (41 unit + 38 CLI).

AX-009.note: ci/verify_ir.sh lowers every example, every benchmark and a targeted runtime corpus and passes each module to clang -c (a real LLVM parse + verify); it is wired into CI and currently verifies 29 modules with 0 failures. The corpus that reaches every runtime subsystem (ints/floats, %ArchxAny incl. the binop helper that was broken, dict/set, regions, SoA structs, tuples/enums/match, comprehensions/sort/zip/generics, input/assert) lives once in src/codegen/tests.rs::RUNTIME_CORPUS, is lowered by the unit test every_runtime_feature_lowers_to_ir, and is written to ci/out/runtime-corpus/ for the shell gate. The gate was proven to fail on a planted bad phi predecessor (the exact v0.9.1 bug shape) before being trusted. NOTE: `llvm-as`/`opt` are not installed in the development sandbox or on the CI images' default PATH, so the frontend is clang's IR parser/verifier, not llvm-as.
